name: PLATO Binary Non-Convex QPLIB Benchmark
description: Benchmarks global optimisation solvers on 128 binary non-convex quadratically constrained programming (QCP) instances from QPLIB, requiring proof of global optimality. All variables are binary and the objective or constraints are non-convex quadratic. The benchmark compares specialised spatial branch-and-bound solvers (BARON, SCIP, ANTIGONE, COUENNE, SHOT, RAPOSa) against commercial MIP solvers.
domain: optimization, quadratic programming, mixed-integer programming, operations research
typical_sota_score: Solvers solve 6–91 of 128 instances; scaled geometric means 1.0–74.9 seconds. 1-hour time limit, 12 threads.
reputation: Comprehensive QCQP benchmark for binary variables; maintained by Hans Mittelmann.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Large variance in solver capability: best solver solves 91/128, weakest only 6/128. Global optimality required (mipgap=zero).
